notes: Read all 234 numbered source lines before editing. Imports L1-4: L1 react (createContext/useCallback/useContext/useEffect/useMemo/useRef/useState/ReactNode) preserved verbatim; L2 react-router-dom useLocation/useNavigate REMOVED — React Native has no DOM History API and the web-parity tree has no in-app router, so the browser Back/Forward URL roll-back + navigate(-1) replay is structurally unavailable (documented in the file header); L3 react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined useNativeTranslationFallback() NativeTFunction returning the web fallback copy; L4 @/components/ui/ConfirmDialog -> inlined native-safe NavigationConfirmDialog (RN Modal) since the ui ConfirmDialog is not in the native manifest.

NavigationGuardEntry interface + its docstring (L6-24) ported verbatim and still exported: id (L14), isDirty (L16), getMessage (L23) with the unchanged JSDoc about reading from refs and the forms.unsavedWarning fallback.

PendingConfirm (L26-29: resolve/(ok:boolean)=>void + optional message) and NavigationGuardContextValue (L31-47: register returns an unregister fn L36; confirmIfDirty L46 with the dedup-in-flight docstring) preserved; the docstring's 'popstate dialog already open' example is reworded to 'hardware-Back dialog already open' to match the native interception path while keeping identical semantics.

Ctx = createContext (L49) and NOOP_CTX (L51-61: register no-op + confirmIfDirty resolving true) preserved verbatim including the no-provider test/Storybook rationale (reworded 'main.tsx' -> 'app root').

NavigationGuardProvider (L80-229) ported with every state name preserved: t (L81 useTranslation -> useNativeTranslationFallback), guards Map ref (L82), pending state (L83), pendingPromiseRef dedup (L84-86). L87-88 navigate/location and L89 lastLocationRef + L94-96 location effect REMOVED (only existed to roll the DOM URL back). L90-92 skipNextPopstateRef -> skipNextBackRef (BackHandler analogue). register (L98-103), findDirty (L105-110), confirmIfDirty (L112-121) ported line-for-line with identical control flow and the [findDirty] dep.

Web popstate interception (L123-178) + resyncUrl state/effect (L135-140): the URL roll-back via window.history.pushState (L155) and react-router resync navigate(replace) (L138) / navigate(-1) replay (L167) have NO native analogue (no DOM History, no host router), so they are dropped and replaced by a BackHandler hardwareBackPress effect that mirrors the web handler's structure — skip-flag short-circuit (L144-147), findDirty gate (L148-149), pendingPromiseRef dedup (L160), and a wrapper resolve that on ok=true sets skipNextBackRef (the native stand-in for navigate(-1), web L164-169) before resolving. Returns true to block Back when dirty, false otherwise. Cleanup removes the subscription. On iOS/macOS/Windows there is no hardware Back so it is inert and the guard relies on confirmIfDirty(), exactly like the web hook path.

ctxValue useMemo (L180-183), pendingRef + mirror effect (L185-195), handleConfirm (L197-203), and handleCancel (L205-211) ported verbatim — same ref-then-setPending(null)-then-resolve ordering that avoids resolving inside a setState updater; the web comment about MemoryRouter setState-during-render is generalized since the trigger (navigate inside updater) is gone on native.

Render (L213-228): Ctx.Provider wraps {children} + the dialog (L214-227). The web <ConfirmDialog> props are mapped 1:1 onto NavigationConfirmDialog — open={pending != null} (L217), title forms.unsavedTitle (L218), message pending?.message ?? forms.unsavedWarning (L219), confirmLabel forms.discard (L220), cancelLabel forms.keepEditing (L221), variant=warning (L222), silenceKey='unsaved-navigation' (L223), onConfirm/onCancel (L224-225). All five i18n keys + default strings preserved exactly.
useNavigationGuardContext (L231-234) ported verbatim: useContext(Ctx) ?? NOOP_CTX. No default export added (web has named exports only).

Inlined NavigationConfirmDialog is a native-safe RN Modal port of the warning-variant subset the provider uses: warning/danger-toned message panel (SemanticIcon name='warning'/'error'), explicit Discard/Keep-editing Pressables, and the silence opt-out. The web ConfirmDialog's localStorage lib/confirmSilence is reimplemented as an in-memory module Set (isSilenced/silence) — single-process native-safe degradation; auto-resolve-when-silenced + reset-dontAskAgain-on-open + suppress-render-when-silenced behaviours preserved. Escape-key cancel maps to Modal onRequestClose + backdrop Pressable; the HTML checkbox becomes an accessibilityRole='checkbox' Pressable toggle.

No DOM-only modules, react-router-dom, react-i18next, lucide-react, web ui ConfirmDialog, window/history, or browser HTML elements are imported — only react, react-native primitives (BackHandler/Modal/Pressable/StyleSheet/View), SemanticIcon, AppText, and theme tokens (colors/shadows/spacing). Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck, npm run lint -- --quiet, and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
